main.description: A plyr.fm artist profile with music-specific metadata.

avatar.description: URL to the avatar image. When avatarBlob is set, this is that blob's getBlob URL, for readers that only read URLs.

avatarBlob.description: Avatar image stored in the artist's repository. Takes precedence over avatar.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.
